text:
maria_g: Rapid sync  we're finalizing social for next Wed's webinar. Need X thread (3 short posts), LinkedIn carousel (4 cards), 15s clip, plus an inbound PM template. Who takes what? :spiral_calendar:

tony_l: I can do the 15s clip + thumbnail. Need final headline + hero image by Tue noon. Will export 16:9 and 9:16.

ben_o: I'll write two stat variants for A/B on X and set UTM mapping. Plan: registrants -> qualifier form -> score>=8 -> SDR-2 else nurture. Using short.redwood.ai/qualify.

jess_p: I'll own LinkedIn copy + 48h moderation. Will batch replies every hour. Please give me 3 pinned reply templates.

sam-bot: Proposed times: "Wed 14:00 UTC: X post 1 (teaser)", "Wed 14:08 UTC: X post 2 (stat + CTA)", "Wed 14:20 UTC: X post 3 (last call)", "Wed 14:30 UTC: LinkedIn carousel". Confirm.

maria_g: Times good. Ben put stat A in X post 2, stat B in carousel. Add CTA short.redwood.ai/qualify on post 2. Set $300 boost for stat post. CPL target <$60.

ben_o: Stat A: "p95 inference latency down 40%". Stat B: "unit cost per call down 28%". UTMs: "?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_sep2026".

tony_l: For exports: 1200x1200 carousel, 1200x630 share image, subtitle-burned clip. ETA Tue EOD for exports.

jess_p: PM script: "Thanks for registering! Can you share your primary LLM use-case in one line? Reply 'demo' for a walkthrough." Will pin that and add 5 canned answers.

maria_g: Final checklist: Tony assets (Tue EOD)  Ben stats + UTMs (Mon EOD)  Jess replies (queued). If any blockers, flag here and we shift schedule 24h.

ben_o: Pinged legal about a short customer quote for card 2. If denied, we slot stat B.

sam-bot: Reminder set: review drafts 30m before first post.

maria_g: Thanks team  please drop the first X post one-liner for tone check.

ben_o: "See how predictable inference changes product economics. Join our 45-min webinar to see the numbers -> short.redwood.ai/qualify"

maria_g: Slight tweak: replace 'product economics' with 'unit economics'. Approved after edit.
